name: Nameless
effect: You can't say your own name.

name: Oathbreaker
effect: You are compelled to break any promise you make or have made.

name: Sunbane
effect: You cannot go into direct sunlight. If you do, you become Injured immediately.

name: Peacebound
effect: You cannot wield a weapon or cause harm.

name: Dispossessed
effect: You must immediately give away all your possessions, and you cannot own any.

name: Wellspring of Feeling
effect: Pick an emotion. You are prone to random bursts of that emotion, especially at inappropriate times.

name: Wellspring of Feeling
effect: Pick an emotion. You are prone to random bursts of that emotion, especially at inappropriate times.

name: Grave News
effect: You immediately receive a letter that someone close to you has died.

name: Tuneless
effect: You have no rhythm, and can only dance or sing very poorly.

name: Ill-Fated
effect: You are unlucky, and automatically lose games of chance and skill.

name: Truthbound
effect: You cannot lie. If you do, you become Injured immediately.

name: Botched Brew
effect: Any time you brew a potion, it results in a mishap.

name: Unflattering Epithet
effect: Your name permanently gains an unflattering epithet (like Greg "Smelly" Gregore). You must use it when introducing yourself and request others use it too.

name: Illiterate
effect: You lose the ability to read.
